issues: Checked OK (licence): Commons API extmetadata re-read 2026-09-23. LicenseShortName 'CC BY 2.0', License 'cc-by-2.0', LicenseUrl creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0, AttributionRequired true, Artist 'Web Summit', categories include 'Category:CC-BY-2.0', 'Tim Berners-Lee' and 'Web Summit (2018)'. The Commons page text 'It was reviewed on 9 November 2018 by FlickreviewR 2 and was confirmed to be licensed under the terms of the cc-by-2.0' is FOUND. The upstream Flickr page (flickr.com/photos/websummit/44822699885) still returns HTTP 200 and still carries license id 4 / creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0, so the licence has not changed.

Checked OK (caption): the Commons description '5 November 2018; Tim Berners-Lee, inventor of the World Wide Web, backstage during the Web Summit 2018 Opening Ceremony at the Altice Arena in Lisbon, Portugal. Photo by Stephen McCarthy/Web Summit via Sportsfile' is FOUND with fetch-text --check. DateTimeOriginal is 2018-11-05 19:32. The creator and creditLine match this description. Independent source: the Guardian, 5 Nov 2018 ('tim-berners-lee-launches-campaign-to-save-the-web-from-abuse') says 'In a talk at the opening of the Web Summit in Lisbon on Monday...', which confirms the place and date.

Checked OK ('five weeks after ... Inrupt'): the Inrupt announcement essay 'One Small Step for the Web' is dated 29 Sep 2018 (Common Dreams republication URL /views/2018/09/29/, and 'founded a company called Inrupt' is FOUND there). English Wikipedia gives 30 September 2018. From 29 or 30 Sep to 5 Nov is 36 or 37 days, so 'five weeks' is correct.

Checked OK (crop and local file): I downloaded the full 1920x1280 Commons thumbnail (HTTP 200). It shows two men backstage: a man with a Web Summit 'Adrian' speaker badge on the left and Berners-Lee, with a headset mic, on the right. The caption's 'Cropped to Berners-Lee from a two-person photo' is accurate. The local file assets/media/tim-berners-lee-web-summit-lisbon-2018.jpg opens as a 680x1160 JPEG (matching thumbPx). It shows Berners-Lee in a dark jacket and pale blue shirt with a headset mic, against a dark background with a purple curtain at the right edge, which matches the alt text.
Checked OK (location): the Altice Arena (Parque das Nacoes) is at about 38.768 N, 9.094 W, which matches lat/lng 38.7684, -9.094.

Optional enrichment, not an error: at this opening-night talk Berners-Lee launched the 'Contract for the Web' (Guardian, 5 Nov 2018). That is arguably a more direct privacy hook for the caption than the Inrupt timing.
